assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: one closed 2D romantic anime envelope game sprite, landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG.
Input image role: the supplied accepted envelope is both the exact placement/geometry template and the illustrated quality reference. Make a NEW personality variant. Do not change the accepted original.
ALPHA REQUIREMENT: preserve the reference image's real transparent alpha outside the envelope. Output an actual RGBA PNG with zero-alpha empty pixels, not an illustration of transparency. No solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no vignette, no ground plane, no shadow outside the object, no glow outside the silhouette. Only the closed envelope object.
Geometry invariants: straight-on back/flap side, unrotated, no perspective. Same approximately rectangular closed body, corners at (96,106), (1440,106), (1440,885), (96,885) on a 1536x1024 canvas. Empty margins. Same closed downward triangular flap: top hinge at y106, diagonals from the two top corners to the central seal around (768,535). Do not open the flap, show a lining, an inserted sheet, or add detached floating objects. Keep the main seal compact around x650..885, y415..600, and its ribbon tips inside x574..959,y585..797. Ornament silhouette changes must remain INSIDE the reference envelope footprint and within these flap/seal regions, suitable for a separate hinged flap later. All edges must be fully in frame.
Style: lavish polished otome/shoujo anime illustration, precise drawn outlines, intentional cel shading, bright controlled enamel/gem highlights, original fantasy stationery. No photography, no realistic paper-craft fibers, no tabletop props, no lettering, no watermark, no characters or hands. Material and motif differences must be structural, not a simple hue swap. Return ONE image only.
Personality variant: gentle-floral / 温柔花笺. Gentle, caring and romantic. Pearl-pink translucent-looking illustrated vellum with opalescent lily-white panels, flowing pink-and-gold botanical veins along the triangular flap edges, delicate lily-of-the-valley pearl bell blossoms and blush wild roses integrated at the lower corners. Replace the single chunky heart gem setting with a scalloped rose-petal rosette surrounding a small faceted pink heart, at the same central anchor. The two ribbon tails become soft illustrated rose-silk leaflike folds, with the SAME spatial footprint as the reference. Rounded petal silhouettes and organic tendrils contrast with the original's sharper stars. Fine gold, mint enamel leaves and small pearl beads; a sophisticated tender letter, not a flower bouquet.

rejectedAttempt.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the supplied gentle floral envelope PNG.
Task: remove the entire background to REAL TRANSPARENCY. Preserve the closed illustrated envelope itself, all artwork, precise pixels, rectangle position, scale and colors. Keep image size 1536x1024. This is a production background-removal task, not a new illustration.
The previous file is RGB without an alpha channel. The required output is PNG with an actual fourth alpha channel. Every pixel outside the envelope silhouette must have alpha 0. Edge pixels should have antialiased alpha. Solid envelope interior alpha 255. Do not draw any transparency visualization or replacement backdrop. Deliver only the transparent object.

geometryReview.coordinateSpace: 1536 x 1024 source image, x rightwards/y downwards. Approximate visual landmarks, uncertainty about +/-16 px; these are not alpha-derived contours or ready clip polygons.

common.flap: Closed downward triangle. Its lower center is occluded by each seal; the actual path behind that seal cannot be recovered from one sealed bitmap.
common.defaultMaskCompatibility: Not verified. Existing flap polygon and heart illumination mask are artwork-specific.
common.underlayer: The existing default RGB body/lining cannot be reused by just replacing the closed sprite. It is masked by original alpha and carries the default material. A new alpha mask alone does not make its colors or exposed detail match.

gentle-floral.conflict: Petal scallops and lateral leaves differ from the accepted gold-heart outline and can straddle its fixed flap/body split. Original heart glow would include some petals.

bright-playful.conflict: Starburst tips and enlarged star gem exceed the original compact seal footprint. Fixed heart illumination would not follow the star and the old flap cut can divide the lower points.

quiet-reserved.conflict: Moonstone extends above the current heart-light region; crescent arcs and pearl pins have different ownership boundaries. Default warm/pink lining would break the cold silver material.

enigmatic-composed.conflict: Oval signet/keyhole needs its own jewel illumination. Light default lining would be conspicuous under a dark flap; closed lacquer art alone does not reveal the correct open underlayer.

geometryReview.handoff: Parent decides matched per-style body/lining assets or source-composited lining plus appropriate flap/jewel geometry. No additional body assets generated in this checkpoint, no controller/Notice/paper CSS changed, no hover/pull acceptance claimed.

selectionProposal.sourceOfIdentity: existing letter.targetRoleId, not display name, locale, model text, world or Math.random
selectionProposal.personalityMapping: Parent maintains a fixed presentation-only targetRoleId -> styleId mapping from known character personality. Gentle/caring -> gentle-floral; bright/playful -> bright-playful; quiet/reserved -> quiet-reserved; enigmatic/composed -> enigmatic-composed.
selectionProposal.fallback: Use accepted arrival-envelope-anime-r19.png for missing/unknown keys and any unapproved/unready candidate.
selectionProposal.stability: Same stable targetRoleId and versioned mapping resolve identically across reload. Resolve from the letter's stored target role, never an unrelated currently active character.
selectionProposal.canonicalEdits: None; this is a presentation proposal only.
